headline: Red Sox hitting the road with momentum in the tank
morning_brew: We finally get back on the field tonight after a breather, and it feels like we are right where we need to be. The boys have been playing with a sense of purpose that we haven't seen in a while, and keeping that focus on the road is the biggest test we have left. Sitting in that second wild card spot with a bit of a cushion is nice, but I've been a Boston sports fan long enough to know better than to get comfortable until the job is actually done.

The way the starters have been chewing through innings lately has been a total game-changer for the staff. It takes the pressure off the guys who have been forced to do more than their fair share of heavy lifting, and it lets us play a much cleaner brand of baseball from first pitch to the final out. If we can keep getting that kind of production on the mound, the rest of the puzzle should fall into place right when we need it most.

My neighbor Rick is currently convinced that the league schedule makers have a vendetta against us, but I told him to save the complaints for another time. We have a set with Texas starting tonight, and it is all about handling our business one series at a time. I am not making any bold predictions because this game likes to humble you just when you think you've got it figured out, so let's just go out there and play hard.
